decisions.reason: The shared-page requirement still validly requires a common footer and dark treatment; the footer-specific color is owned by REQ_WEBSITE_FOOTER and no candidate attribute contains the obsolete purple footer color.
Changing the footer background color does not alter the requirement to omit header navigation.
The provisioning wizard only specifies that the common website footer is optional and stores no footer-color value; that requirement remains valid unchanged.
The sign-in page only specifies an optional common footer and contains no footer-color attribute requiring replacement or removal.
The source explicitly changes purple to dark gray only for the footer; it does not change the landing-page hero background or broader visual theme.
The candidate requires color-token documentation but contains no specific footer background token or Frequency-purple value that the source decision necessarily changes.
The console shell footer is a separate application-shell component; the source decision is expressly limited to the website footer.
A footer background-color change does not alter responsive layout behavior, breakpoint guidance, or any current candidate attribute.
The footer color decision does not change the implementation stack, Astro exclusion, or handoff objective.
